text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 decode latency > 1.2s for 5m on prod-east (service: inference-decoder). Streaming stalls increasing. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood/INC-3512345678

mike: seeing p95 jump to ~420ms and p99 ~1.25s across multiple clusters, errors spike for streaming sessions. customers-reporting: 2 large tenants.

sam: fyi rolled trt8+flashattn kernel across prod-east ~ 03:04 UTC via rollout rb-2026-03-15-ker1. rolling back now?

priya: confirm compile flags used in that kernel build? last diff added `-ffast-math` + `-Ofast-simd` for perf. might be aggressive.

mike: heap/paging metrics show dramatic increases in pagefaults and eviction bytes after rollout. snippet from node logs:
```
W decode_kv_cache.cc:246 evict_count=13142 pages_in=204MB pages_out=198MB latency_us=1240000
E flash_attn_kern.cu:402 pagefault during mmap: errno=12
```

alexa: starting rollback on prod-east nodepool inference-rt-2 now. command I'm running:
```
rbctl rollout undo --id rb-2026-03-15-ker1 --env prod-east --wait
```

ops-oncall: scaled dedicated GPU pool by +8 nodes to absorb traffic during rollback. routing policy set to prefer non-flash kernels: `route_pref: kernel_variant!=flashattn`

sam: adding temporary kernel-fallback in config to avoid flashattn path while we triage: `INFERENCE_FORCE_KERN=baseline` on service deploy.

mike: after partial rollback on ~30% of nodes p95 is down to 92ms, p99 260ms. streaming sessions recovering. still watching tail.

priya: looking at assembly diffs — `-ffast-math` caused FP reorder that changes memory access pattern in fused kernels. hypothesis: increased working set -> more page faults under our allocator. also saw changed register pressure in nvcc output.

oncall-sre: forwarding to infra team to run a rebuild with safer flags and full memory-safety checks. assigning BUG-IR-2112.

mike: creating short checklist for mitigation ops: 
- rollback rollout id on all prod-east nodes (in progress)
- set INFERENCE_FORCE_KERN=baseline globally
- scale GPU pool + autoscale lock for 15m
- add alert for pagefault rate > 50/s to catch regressions early

alexa: handoff to next oncall for 08:00 UTC. key notes for handoff: rollback complete on 100% prod-east, p95/p99 stable at 80/220ms, follow-up required: rebuild kernel without `-ffast-math`, run benchmark with long-tail streaming workload.

priya: adding reproduction steps to BUG-IR-2112: run streaming-load with kv-cache churn and allocator stress; test kernels compiled with `-O2` vs `-Ofast` and with/without `-ffast-math`.

oncall-sre: got CI job queued to build safe-kernel candidate (job: ci-kern-351234) and run in canary pool with spike simulation. will update thread when canary completes.

sam: also flagging model-serving config for batching changes — disable large continuous-batching during canary to reduce working set.

mike: customers notified via status page post that we saw degraded streaming for ~20-30m and mitigation is complete, follow-up patch incoming.

alexa: leaving a brief runbook entry in /runbooks/paging-kernel-regress.md about this pattern (compiler flag -> increased page faults -> tail latency). please add any extra steps you used. cc @priya @sam

incident-bot: Incident INC-3512345678 annotated: severity=high, status=mitigated, owner=oncall-sre, followup=BUG-IR-2112, sla-impact=p99-exceedance.

oncall-sre: handing off — next oncall please verify canary results and coordinate kernel rebuild with eng-runtime.

mike: ack, will watch overnight and follow up in morning with perf numbers and canary logs. :thumbsup:
